global_changes.note: Invulnerability targeting rules of certain items and abilities have been updated
Most items and abilities that previously could target and/or affect invulnerable units no longer do so
Added a preview for effects, profile backgrounds, teleport effects and high fives

abilities.name: Chaos Bolt
description: Fires a mysterious bolt of energy at the target enemy, stunning them for a random duration and dealing random damage. Minimum stun duration: 1.25 / 1.5 / 1.75 / 2. Maximum stun duration: 1.75 / 2.25 / 2.75 / 3.25. Minimum damage: 90 / 120 / 150 / 180. Maximum damage: 155 / 240 / 325 / 410. Cooldown: 13 / 12 / 11 / 10. Cast range: 600. Mana cost: 110.

abilities.name: Reality Rift
description: Teleports the hero, all their illusions, and the targeted enemy to a point between the caster and the target. Reduces the target's armor for 6 sec. Pull distance: 300 / 350 / 400 / 450. Armor reduction: -4 / -5 / -6 / -7. Cooldown: 18 / 15 / 12 / 9. Cast range: 600 / 650 / 700 / 750. Mana cost: 50.

abilities.name: Chaos Strike
description: The hero and their illusions have a chance to perform a critical attack of random strength and restore health based on a portion of the damage dealt. Lifesteal from creeps is reduced. Chance: 33.33%. Minimum critical damage: 120%. Maximum critical damage: 140% / 180% / 220% / 260%. Lifesteal on trigger: 24% / 36% / 48% / 60%.

abilities.name: Phantasm
description: Summons several copies of the hero from parallel dimensions. The copies are illusions, deal 100% damage, and take 350% damage. DISPEL TYPE: basic. Number of illusions: 1 / 2 / 3. Illusion duration: 30. Illusion damage: 100%. Damage taken by illusions: 350%. Cooldown: 75. Mana cost: 100 / 200 / 300.

abilities.name: Starbreaker
description: The hero swings the hammer around three times, dealing bonus attack damage to enemies. On the final swing, the hero smashes the hammer into the ground, stunning enemies in front and dealing damage. Duration: 1.1. Swing and smash radius: 300. Bonus damage from swings and smash: 25 / 40 / 55 / 70. Stun duration: 0.6 / 0.8 / 1 / 1.2. Cooldown: 17 / 15 / 13 / 11. Mana cost: 100.

abilities.name: Celestial Hammer
description: The hero throws their hammer at a target, damaging all enemies along its path. The hammer pauses for 2 sec., then returns, leaving a slowing fire trail behind. The hero can call the hammer early to fly toward it and meet it in the middle. Hammer damage: 50 / 80 / 110 / 140. Fire trail duration: 2.5 / 3 / 3.5 / 4. Fire trail radius: 200. Movement slow from fire trail: 24% / 28% / 32% / 36%. Fire trail damage per second: 20 / 30 / 40 / 50. Cast range: 700 / 900 / 1100 / 1300. Cooldown: 18 / 16 / 14 / 12. Mana cost: 100 / 110 / 120 / 130.

abilities.name: Luminosity
description: After several attacks, the hero becomes empowered, causing the next attack to deal critical damage and heal all allied heroes within 650 for 50% of the damage. Healing from attacks on creeps or neutrals is reduced. Attacks to trigger: 3. Healing from attack on hero: 35% / 40% / 45% / 50%. Reduced healing when attacking creeps: 40%. Critical damage: 125% / 150% / 175% / 200%.

abilities.name: Solar Guardian
description: INTERRUPTIBLE — the hero creates a pulsing effect within 350 of any allied hero. Each pulse damages enemies and heals allies. After a brief preparation, the hero flies to the target area, dealing additional damage and stunning enemies upon landing. Once this ability begins, it cannot be interrupted. Heal per pulse: 45 / 70 / 95. Landing radius: 500. Damage per pulse: 30 / 50 / 70. Landing damage: 130 / 160 / 190. Stun duration: 1.4 / 1.6 / 1.8. Flight duration: 0.8. Cooldown: 120 / 105 / 90. Mana cost: 150 / 200 / 250.
